critical_defects.finding: At friction cue k=5 the balloon center is 380 and rightmost body x=478, whereas wall starts x=550: 72 px visible separation. Closing k=6 reaches at most x=503, still 47 px away. Friction cannot support an object that is not in contact.

At k=5 add upward static-friction and downward weight arrows, equal for this resting case. Either label selected vertical forces or also show the horizontal contact reaction and electric attraction.

For k=5 draw two matching initially dry intact glasses in the same room: cold surface below local dew point with drops; room-temperature surface above dew point dry. Qualitative labels suffice; do not introduce a universal temperature.
